newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan share prices seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan share prices seen consolidating.

text.p: Taiwan stocks are expected to consolidate on Thursday amid investor caution over the military conflicts between the United States and Iraq, brokers said.
"The impact of the Iraq tension is gradually diminishing, but most individual investors prefer to take a cautious line," said Michael Chien of China Securities.

But brokers noted institutions have showed interest in hunting bargains. Electronics, which have risen in recent sessions, will continue to be the market focus. On Wednesday, the index finished down 29.19 points or 0.47 percent at 6,228.78. A range of 6,150-6,250 was seen.-Alice Hung 5080815
